en: A black and white photograph showing an old European town situated on hilly terrain. The foreground features a large, rectangular building with many windows and a steep tiled roof, likely a historical institution or monastery. Behind it, a baroque-style church with a tall steeple is visible, surrounded by smaller houses and lush greenery. The hills in the background are dotted with scattered houses and trees.
